name: special-offer

frames.best_why: Whole banner in view: glowing headline, all four countdown tiles and the promo-code box; only the seconds differ.
frames.render_note: Promo code box is clipped by the right edge and the 'Limited Time Offer' label is cut off at the top.

tagline: Cyber sale strip with a glowing countdown and a boxed promo code.
summary: A full-width bar for a limited-time sale: copy on the left, a countdown of days, hours, minutes and seconds in the middle, and a boxed discount code on the right. It ticks down each second, then swaps to an ended message.
appearance: A wide dark bar with a warm orange glow behind the left copy, fading to near-black on the right. The left column holds a small blue label, a white headline and a highlighted paragraph. Four square countdown tiles follow, the first orange and the rest blue, split by colons, ending in a bordered promo-code box.
behaviour: The countdown drops once per second while the four tiles keep their values padded to two digits. Once the target date passes, the banner is replaced by a short 'Sale Ended!' message. Nothing responds to hover, click or keyboard.
demo_content: Cyber sale copy advertising 30% off with the code CBRLAYOUT, counting down to 31 December 2026.
search_phrases: limited time offer strip with timer
promo code bar across the page
sale countdown with days hours minutes seconds
black friday banner with glowing numbers
website banner showing percent off and coupon
use_when: You want a loud, self-contained sale banner that keeps the deadline visible while the page is open.
avoid_when: The target date, copy and promo code are hardcoded, so every new campaign needs a source edit.
customise: No props: the sale copy, promo code and countdown target date are written into the file, so changing them means editing the source. Colours come from utility classes.
weight_why: One interval per second updating four numbers; nothing heavy renders.

a11y.note: The ticking countdown is plain text and never announced to screen readers; the pulsing colons ignore reduced-motion settings.

issues: The promo code box runs off the right edge in every frame
The 'Limited Time Offer' label is clipped at the top
The left copy column is narrow, leaving a wide empty gap before the countdown
polish_why: Coherent glow and countdown, but cramped copy column and clipped edges keep it ordinary.
